text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The study-with-me video is getting quite 
a few views. Nice, nice!"

The DIY sauna video meant to promote 
Yukoma Onsen. Its view count seems to be 
rising little by little. However――

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Tran? Is something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, well... Yeah. A bit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, that unique 
excitement? Thrill? I just feel like we 
could use more of that.”
choice_data_list: Ah, I kind of get it...

text_block_list.text:
It's turning into a fine sauna hut, but 
right now it's just an ordinary sauna. If 
only it had a little something more 
interesting...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go search for some ideas!

text_block_list.text:
As I stepped outside, the late-summer sun 
was shining down brilliantly.

Within the warm air, a faint scent of the 
forest drifted by. The breeze caressing my 
cheeks felt wonderful.

Led along by the wind, I climbed the 
mountain pass. Before long, I reached a 
spot that overlooked the scenery below.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I thought it was a pretty long road, 
and it turns out it goes all the way out 
here~.
choice_data_list:
The scenery's beautiful, what a nice, 
refreshing place.

The scenery's beautiful, it's such a nice, 
refreshing place, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainy, do that thing. You know, that 
classic mountain thing.

After thinking for a moment, I understood. 
The classic mountain activity. That would, 
of course, be—
(Yahoooooooo......!!)
(Yahoooooooo......)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that really echoes~~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do it too. 
Yaaaaaa-hooooooooooooo!!

"Beneath an endlessly stretching blue sky, 
echoes resonated crisp and clear across 
the mountains."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... it makes me just want to lie 
down right here and look at the scenery 
forever~."

I nod at Transcend's words and look up at 
the sky. I really am starting to feel like 
lying down. Maybe if we set up a hammock 
right here—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, so you want to put a hammock here, 
do you?

I suggested that relaxing in a hammock by 
the river after the sauna would be the 
ultimate way to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds super nice. Seems like 
it'd be relaxing, and—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —That looks crazy fun.

"This might be the answer to that 
'something' I was missing. I decided to 
get straight to work."

By the time we finished the work and 
returned to the log cabin, the sun had 
completely set.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was hard work. I'm starving, so 
maybe I'll go get some hot spring cola 
again today.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Oryo?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Nisshishi. Trai-chan. I found something 
really good.
(Slurp slurp...)

What Transcend found was instant cup 
noodles. Boiling water on the log house's 
stove, the two of us slurped our noodles 
together.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Haaah... The salt really soaks in.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's so good just from adding hot water... 
Cup ramen is honestly way too 
incredible~...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wish they just sold the freeze-dried 
meat on its own... Wonder if anyone sells 
it~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let me look it up. Umm... the mystery meat 
in cup noodles is—

Eating cup noodles while having casual, 
idle chit-chat somehow felt richer and 
tastier than usual.
